Live TypeSafe Jev comparison for a single pair of samples

Source: R/typesafe_live.R
typesafe_compare_pair_live.Rd

Compare two writing samples on one trait using TypeSafe's binary Choice API, POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone. The default is the exact approved decision_cj_v1 instructions, with the complete trait description preserved. This opt-in helper uses the same scientific request, integrity validator, response parser, and binary winner semantics as OpenAI Decisions.

Usage

typesafe_compare_pair_live(
  ID1,
  text1,
  ID2,
  text2,
  model = "jev-1.13.0",
  trait_name,
  trait_description,
  prompt_template = NULL,
  api_key = NULL,
  include_raw = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

ID1, ID2

Distinct nonempty character scalar sample IDs, in presentation order. Reversing the presentation reverses the sample-to-position mapping.

text1, text2

Nonmissing character scalar sample texts. Empty strings are allowed. Whitespace, Unicode characters, and line endings are preserved.

model

Requested model identifier. Defaults to the explicit version "jev-1.13.0". Other jev-<major>.<minor>.<patch> identifiers and the documented aliases "jev-latest" and "jev-preview" are accepted. Identifiers are checked for syntax, not availability; TypeSafe determines whether the account can use them. No model-list preflight, version allowlist, substitution, or automatic fallback is used. Prefer versioned identifiers for reproducible research: aliases can resolve differently over time.

trait_name

Nonempty character scalar trait label.

trait_description

Nonempty character scalar containing the full trait definition, including construct boundaries; inserted verbatim.

prompt_template

Must be omitted or NULL. Generative templates are rejected. Use decision_template in ... for custom decision instructions.

api_key

Optional character scalar TypeSafe key. NULL or "" uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY through the shared credential resolver. Explicit keys take precedence; missing, malformed, whitespace-containing, or control-character keys fail without printing their values. Persist credentials in .Renviron and restart R, or use Sys.setenv(TYPESAFE_API_KEY = "YOUR_KEY_HERE") for the current session. check_llm_api_keys() reports presence only.

include_raw

Logical scalar. Retain successful parsed responses when TRUE. Failed decision responses are always retained for diagnosis.

...

Only pair_uid and decision_template are supported, and must be uniquely named. pair_uid identifies the scheduled pair occurrence; its default is "LIVE_<ID1>_vs_<ID2>". Custom decision_template instructions must contain {TRAIT_NAME} and {TRAIT_DESCRIPTION}, and must not contain sample placeholders or generative output tags. Custom instructions are fingerprinted. Sampling, reasoning, token limits, caching, storage, tiers, arbitrary URLs/headers, and long-context/image controls are unsupported, including explicitly supplied NULL settings. Unknown settings fail before credential resolution or HTTP.

Value

A one-row tibble with the shared decision_results columns:

ID1, ID2, pair_uid, custom_id

Presentation and scheduled pair identity.

better_sample, better_id, winner_pos

Explicit selected sample label, corresponding ID, and integer presentation position.

p_sample_1, p_sample_2, p_chosen, probabilities_json

Both provider probabilities, the selected probability, and the full binary map.

decision_confidence

Independent provider-reported confidence; never inferred from or substituted for the selected probability.

requested_model, resolved_model, model

Requested identifier, provider-reported identifier (NA when absent), and resolved identifier when supplied, otherwise the requested identifier. Missing resolution metadata does not establish which model weights served an alias.

prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens

Reported input, output, and total usage; unavailable counts are NA, not inferred. Shared cached/write/reasoning token columns are also retained if supplied.

endpoint, decision_question, decision_type, decision_template_version, request_fingerprint, request_provenance_json

Scientific identity. Provenance includes provider, full trait/instructions/criteria, ordered IDs, and exact text hashes.

provider_request_id

Optional x-request-id header, otherwise NA.

object_type, status_code, error_message

"decision", HTTP status, and sample-free decision failure detail (NA on success).

decision_error_code, decision_error_detail

Shared response-validation failure classification and detail; NA on success.

thoughts, content

NA; this endpoint does not generate assessment prose.

retry_failures

List-column of preceding transient attempt records.

raw_response

Optional parsed response, always present on decision failure, including malformed output and inconsistent probabilities.

Details

The wire request contains model, state (a JSON string with exactly the ordered SAMPLE_1 and SAMPLE_2 texts), and a questions map with one writing_trait entry. Its type is choice, with rendered instructions and symmetric SAMPLE_1/SAMPLE_2 criteria descriptions. Responses use an answers map with choice, a complete probabilities map, and confidence.

The shared integrity validator checks the complete scientific body against recorded provenance and its SHA-256 fingerprint before provider operations. The serialized JSON is checked again, attached as raw UTF-8 bytes, and checked with the URL/content type before every HTTP attempt. Altered requests fail with pairwiseLLM_decision_request_error, without repair or HTTP. This is an integrity/reproducibility guard, not an authenticated signature.

Exactly two finite probabilities in [0,1], summing to 1 within 1e-6, and finite confidence in [0,1] are required. Values are never renormalized, clipped, rounded, complemented, or fabricated. Exact 0, 0.5, and 1 survive. The explicit choice is retained; if the alternative exceeds its probability by more than 1e-8, the result fails with choice_probability_mismatch. Missing confidence, malformed/unknown answer types, incomplete distributions, and invalid usage are classified by the shared parser. TypeSafe has no documented refusal variant; unknown types are malformed. These response failures are not retried and are excluded by the shared normalizer before modeling. Only successful normalized results are model evidence.

HTTP 408, 429, all 5xx statuses (including 529), and timeouts receive up to three total attempts with exponential delays of 0.5 and 1 second. Requests retain identical validated bytes. Other transport failures and permanent HTTP errors, including authentication, unavailable models, and schema errors, abort. Conditions have sample-free/key-free messages and retry_failures; HTTP conditions also carry status_code. Backoff uses the package's shared retry helper; it does not currently interpret Retry-After headers.

Only the standard text endpoint is supported: no SDK is required, and no compression, long-context/image opt-in, or managed Batch is implemented here. Use submit_typesafe_pairs_live() for resumable live bulk collection. The provider enforces body/context limits. An owner-authorized live smoke run on 2026-10-16 exercised jev-1.13.0 through this endpoint on 20 synthetic samples (60 primary pairs and 10 reverse audits); other versions/aliases were not qualified. See the model-compatibility vignette for the tested commit, design and limits. Model probabilities do not establish validated educational assessment accuracy and do not become BT/adaptive weights, fractional wins, or judgments.

Sample text is sent to TypeSafe. Keys are omitted from diagnostics. Request bodies and raw responses can contain private text; sample-free provenance still includes possibly sensitive custom instructions and trait definitions. Avoid logging them publicly. This helper provides no data-retention control.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Requires TYPESAFE_API_KEY and incurs provider usage charges.
result <- typesafe_compare_pair_live(
  "A", "Synthetic sample A.", "B", "Synthetic sample B.",
  trait_name = "Organization",
  trait_description = "Logical sequencing and connections between ideas."
)
result$better_id
result$p_sample_1

# The same backend through the public dispatcher:
llm_compare_pair(
  "A", "Synthetic sample A.", "B", "Synthetic sample B.",
  model = "jev-1.13.0", backend = "typesafe",
  trait_name = "Organization",
  trait_description = "Logical sequencing and connections between ideas."
)
} # }
